chunks: As for whatever is in it from Rubay ibn Abdullah, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Sa'd ibn Abdullah and al-Himyari together, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Rubay ibn Abdullah ibn Jarud al-Hudhali.
And he was an Arab from Basra.

key_terms.الْحِمْيَرِيِّ: al-Himyari, one of the transmitting authorities in the chain
key_terms.رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Rubay ibn Abdullah, the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads
key_terms.عَرَبِيٌّ بَصْرِيٌّ: an Arab from Basra; a brief biographical identification

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Rubay ibn Abdullah in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from Rubay ibn Abdullah. It also briefly identifies Rubay ibn Abdullah ibn Jarud al-Hudhali as an Arab from Basra, making the report primarily one of transmission-chain clarification and narrator identification.
